verdict.rationale: Aleph claims versioned forecasts and scenario modeling (aleph-docs-3) and lists audit logs among its enterprise security features (aleph-docs-25), which together suggest some scenario versioning and change tracking. Nothing shows that each scenario records its assumptions or attributes assumption changes to specific users, and the audit logs are described only generically. missing for 10: per-scenario assumption recording, user attribution of assumption changes within scenarios, auditable scenario-to-scenario comparison, detailed docs or independent corroboration.
